screenshot.scope: First two metric rows (panels 1–6), historical benchmark window. Logs validated separately in a post-creation window.

logs_evidence_review.method: Focused actual Grafana Logs panel browser capture over existing SSM tunnel; StartQuery response ID correlated with GetQueryResults request ID.
logs_evidence_review.classification: StartQuery defines the executed window. GetQueryResults polls that existing query; its generic six-hour request envelope does not start a query or redefine its window.
logs_evidence_review.prior_summary_resolution: The previous summaries omitted action/query identity, so the old second record could not be conclusively classified from retained local evidence. Both summaries were replaced with this fresh unambiguous capture.

terminal_status_verification.method: Read-only CloudWatch GetQueryResults for the same query ID, returning status only.

limitations: Successful queries and sparse/no-data frames are not a performance measurement.
Historical benchmark predates recreated log groups; Logs use the recorded post-creation window.
